title: AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All (MFA, Sept 27, 2024)
notes: MFA (primary/official), 2024-09-27, full text. AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All: bridge AI/digital divides, help Global South; uphold UN role, UNGA Res A/RES/78/311, 2030 Agenda; North-South/South-South/triangular. 5 goals: infrastructure connectivity, AI+ industries, AI literacy/personnel training, data security/diversity, safety/reliability/controllability. China's actions: joint labs, model R&D cooperation, international cooperation platform, short/medium-term capacity-building programs for developing countries, 10 AI workshops/seminars by end-2025, AI literacy (women/children digital rights), data infrastructure, strategy synergies.
